overview: The STATUS pong has an empty corpus: zero of the 50 anticheats reference S01PacketPong or PacketStatusOutPong. The echo runs before encryption and world state, carries a single client timestamp, and feeds only the server-list latency display, so there is nothing for a server-side anticheat to measure or flag. Ping spoofing that anticheats do care about targets the play-state keepalive, not this packet.
